about.body: The TDV6 and SDV6 are 3.0-litre V6 diesel engines, part of the Ford Lion V6 / M57D30 family, developed jointly by Ford and Land Rover. The engines were produced from 2004 to 2019 and fitted across three Land Rover model lines — the Discovery (L319 D3/D4), the Range Rover (L322/L405), and the Range Rover Sport (L320/L494). The TDV6 uses a single turbocharger with lower power output (211-258 PS), while the SDV6 uses twin turbochargers with higher power output (292-306 PS). Both share the same engine block and key components, though the SDV6 is effectively a tuned version of the TDV6. We work on both variants and treat the same critical inspection points — particularly the crankshaft and timing chain system — regardless of which badge it carries. Rebuilds start from £2,400.

byModel.body: Across the Discovery (L319 D3/D4) , the TDV6 and SDV6 were fitted throughout its production from 2004 to 2016, spanning both the Discovery 3 and Discovery 4 generations. In the Range Rover (L322/L405) , the TDV6/SDV6 appeared from 2006 through to the end of L405 production in 2019, covering two full generations. The Range Rover Sport (L320/L494) also carried the TDV6 and SDV6 across its first two generations, from 2005 to 2019. These three model lines represent the full application set for this engine family in Land Rover's range.

compatibility.body: The TDV6 and SDV6 share the same 3.0-litre V6 block and key components, but TDV6 vs SDV6 variants differ significantly — the TDV6 uses a single turbocharger with lower power output (211-258 PS), while the SDV6 uses twin turbochargers with higher power output (292-306 PS) and effectively represents a tuned version of the same engine. Registration/VIN matching is essential before confirming any rebuild or replacement.
